categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in water environment comprehensive services, industrial wastewater treatment comprehensive services, and small town environmental comprehensive services. It provides project investment, technology R&D, design and construction, equipment manufacturing and integration, and project operation services in the environmental protection sector. Key business areas include municipal sewage treatment, industrial wastewater treatment, rural water environment governance, and integrated water environment management.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced water treatment technologies such as AAO, SBR, oxidation ditch processes, and zero discharge technologies for industrial wastewater. It emphasizes integrated solutions combining technology and operation, including smart water management platforms using IoT, AI, and digital twin technologies. The company also develops specialized equipment like high-efficiency flotation devices, biological reactors, and ozone oxidation reactors, focusing on energy-saving and low-carbon operation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include municipal governments, industrial parks, and enterprises across sectors such as petrochemical, coal chemical, steel, pharmaceuticals, food and beverage, automotive manufacturing, and textiles. The company serves over 20 provinces and municipalities in China and has expanded into overseas markets including Ethiopia. Major clients include city drainage management offices and industrial wastewater management companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China covering Anhui, East China, South China, Central and Southwest China, Northwest, North, and Northeast China regions. It also has overseas operations, notably in Ethiopia and Norway. The company has over 100 sewage treatment plants nationwide and multiple subsidiaries in various provinces.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the environmental protection supply chain, focusing on project investment, engineering construction (EPC), equipment manufacturing, and operation and maintenance of water treatment facilities. It also engages in design consulting and technology development, providing integrated solutions from design to operation.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing smart water management, low-carbon and energy-efficient water treatment technologies, and integrated basin-wide water environment governance. R&D focuses on innovative treatment processes like hydrogen-based denitrification, advanced oxidation, membrane bioreactors, and AI-driven operational optimization. The company collaborates with top universities and research institutes and leads national and provincial technology projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through a combination of investment and operation of water treatment projects under PPP, BOT, TOT, BOO, and O&M models, engineering construction contracts (EPC), equipment manufacturing and sales, and water environment design consulting services. The company recognizes revenue based on contract progress and service delivery, including operation fees and construction income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's water environment governance industry with strong brand recognition and a comprehensive industry chain. It competes with large state-owned enterprises and private environmental firms, leveraging its technology and operation integration advantage. It is recognized as a top influential water industry enterprise and consistently ranks among China's top environmental companies.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.84 billion, a 7.04% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 366.7 million, down 6.54%. Despite revenue decline mainly due to reduced engineering business, operating services and equipment sales grew. Total assets reached RMB 16.46 billion, with steady growth in net assets. The company maintains positive cash flow and continues to invest in R&D and project expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its full-industry-chain service capability, integrating technology innovation with operational excellence to provide one-stop water environment solutions. Its proprietary advanced treatment technologies and smart operation platforms enable high-efficiency, low-carbon, and cost-effective water treatment. The company’s strong R&D partnerships and extensive project experience differentiate it in delivering customized, scalable, and sustainable environmental solutions.
